title: Stelio Kontos
blurb: STELIO KONTOS — the theme of Dexter's Laboratory's most menacing character, a man whose entire personality is intimidation. The music is so dramatically over-the-top for a children's cartoon that the internet adopted it as universal approach music. Play it when someone walks in with bad intentions and worse energy.
origin: The theme of Stelio Kontos from Dexter's Laboratory.
